# Profile Posts Scraper for LinkedIn [No Cookies]

The Apify actor [`apimaestro/linkedin-profile-posts`](https://apify.com/apimaestro/linkedin-profile-posts) as typed Telo kinds, generated from its build **0.1.64**. The module's version is that build number, and every run it starts is pinned to exactly that build, so the input types below are the ones the actor really runs with.

Scrape LinkedIn posts data for a given LinkedIn profile including post content, reactions, comments count, and media attachments

## Pricing

Pay per event — result $0.005 (Free-plan prices; paid plans pay less). Cap the spend with `maxTotalChargeUsd`.

Runs are charged to the Apify account whose token the `ApifyClient` holds. See the [Store page](https://apify.com/apimaestro/linkedin-profile-posts) for current prices.

## Import

```yaml
imports:
  Actor: oci://ghcr.io/telorun/apify/apimaestro-linkedin-profile-posts@0.1.64#sha256-…
```

Pin the digest with `telo upgrade`. The module re-exports `ApifyClient`, so it is the only import needed.

## Usage

```yaml
kind: Actor.ApifyClient
metadata: { name: apify }
token: !cel "secrets.apifyToken"
---
kind: Actor.Run          # or Actor.Start for runs longer than 5 minutes
metadata: { name: scrape }
client: !ref apify
maxTotalChargeUsd: 1     # optional: timeout, memory, maxItems, maxTotalChargeUsd
---
kind: Run.Sequence
metadata: { name: main }
steps:
  - name: scrape
    invoke: !ref scrape
    inputs:
      username: "satyanadella"
```

- **`Run`** calls Apify's synchronous endpoint and returns `{ items }`. Apify holds the request open for at most 300 seconds; a longer run fails with HTTP 408.
- **`Start`** starts the run, long-polls it until it finishes, and returns `{ run, items }`. A run that ends `FAILED`, `TIMED-OUT` or `ABORTED` raises `APIFY_RUN_NOT_SUCCEEDED` with the run as `data`.

## Input

Only these fields are accepted — `telo check` rejects any other.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `username` | string | yes | `"satyanadella"` | Profile Username or Url — LinkedIn profile username (e.g., 'satyanadella' or  'linkedin.com/in/satyanadella') |
| `page_number` | integer |  | `1` | Page Number — Page number for pagination (first page returns a pagination token for subsequent pages) |
| `pagination_token` | string \| null |  |  | Pagination Token — Token from previous page response for paginated requests (optional, only needed for pages after first). For example, to get result from page 2, use pagination token from response of page 1 |
| `limit` | integer |  | `100` | Result limit — Optional: Limit the number of results per page (1-100) |
| `total_posts` | integer |  |  | Total Posts to Scrape (if set, it will override manual pagination settings) — Enable automatic pagination: Set the total number of posts to scrape. This will override manual pagination settings. |

## Output

The actor publishes no dataset schema, so `items` are untyped objects.
